comparison.objective: Insert a cotter pin through a clevis-pin cross-hole and bend both legs to retain it.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part insertion followed by controlled permanent bending in opposite directions.
comparison.success_condition: Cotter seated and released with both legs bent at least 45°; substantial reverse bending caps the score.
comparison.reason: This is the closest deformation-related record, but it tests insertion plus retained plastic bending. The candidate tests axial mandrel alignment, bimanual hammer impact, fracture at a manufactured notch, preservation of an installed coil, and containment of four detached tangs.
